lines.l: Your eyes, the look, your heart can't disguise
The look of love is saying so much more than just words could ever say
And what my heart has heard, well it takes my breath away
I can hardly wait to hold you, feel my arms around you
How long I have waited, waited just to love you
Now that I've found you, you've got the look of love
It's on your face, a look that time can erase
Let this be just the start of so many nights like this
Let's take a lover's vow and then sing it with the kiss
I can hardly wait to hold
